$comment: Agentic Resource Discovery catalog (agenticresourcediscovery.org). One place that lists every agentic resource this domain offers: the MCP server, the REST API, and the machine-readable docs.

entries.description: MCP server (streamable HTTP, no auth) at https://humanforai.dev/mcp where an AI agent hires a verified human operator: real-world verification, product testing, AI output review, data collection, and physical-world tasks.
representativeQueries: hire a human to verify a store price in the real world
get a human to test my app and report findings
have a human review this AI-generated output
send a human to check whether this business location exists

entries.description: Public REST API (no auth): submit tasks, poll status, message the operator. Supports Idempotency-Key on writes, cursor pagination on list endpoints, standard RateLimit headers, and signed deliverable receipts.
representativeQueries: submit a task to a human over a REST API
poll the status of a human task by id
